text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT detected — elevated 5xx on service `prompt-routing` (routing-experimental-v2). Paging oncall.
sara: seeing a quick spike in 500s to /v1/prompt-route/new-endpoint, canary ~30% traffic. alerts from grafana.
jim: oncall here, joining. grabbing logs and traces now. any direct customer reports?
carmen: CS: one customer (acct #42) reported timeouts ~2m ago, others haven't said anything yet. I can prep a quick notification if impact confirmed.
liam: infra: initial logs show repeated model load failures on a subset of GPU nodes in us-west-2 — `RuntimeError: CUDA OOM when allocating` in worker-3/7.
sara: can we isolate canary traffic and flip the feature? we should kill the experimental routing FF if that's the vector.
jim: command to flip: `redwood feature toggle set prompt-routing-experimental false --env prod` (will route to stable backend).
sara: running the toggle now.
incident-bot: AUDIT: feature toggle `prompt-routing-experimental` disabled by sara at 1715004335.
sara: errors dropped back to baseline within ~30s after toggle, but we had inflight failures — collecting traces for those requests.
carmen: CS: starting customer outbound using the canary-fallback template, will ping product and sales if any escalations.
product-ops: use `templates/outage-canary-fallback.md` and include timeline + mitigation steps.
liam: we should still roll back the deploy that added the new endpoint; suspect bad interaction with model initialization under certain mem patterns. candidate commit: `abc1234` in prompt-gateway.
jim: initiating rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/prompt-gateway -n prod --to-revision=3`
sara: rollback started — watching pods come up.
deploy-bot: ROLLBACK initiated by jim at 1715004370.
product-ops: notify sales for customers with retry counts > 3 and prepare advisory to affected accounts.
carmen: CS: advisory sent to two highest-touch customers; tracking replies.
jim: oncall handoff — I need to step away for ~30m. handing to liam for RCA and next steps.
liam: ack, taking over. pairing with infra to reproduce the OOM locally and check kernel/runtime changes.
sara: recommend triggering a postmortem + severity classification. I'm thinking Sev2 given customer reports and rollback.
product-ops: agreed Sev2. opening incident ticket and linking this thread.
incident-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-045 (severity 2).
carmen: customer update: 2 customers confirmed brief errors; most recovered via client retries. No data loss reported.
sara: closing active paging loop — will monitor metrics for 30m and then transition to RCA owners (liam + infra).
jim: thanks everyone, appreciate the quick coord :heart:
product-ops: adding action items: RCA, test for model init OOM, add extra guard in canary config, and improve automatic FF rollback playbook.
liam: noted — will own RCA and PR for canary guardrails.
carmen: I'll follow up with customers with a short incident summary once RCA draft is ready.
